site.arxiv.org "How Much Is an AI Token Worth"

sources_considered.why: Full page and relevant passages read. It measures signs of AI authorship in sampled English-language webpages.
Full abstract page read. It measures AI text surviving web-data filtering and experimentally trains models on such text.
The search result concerns detector classifications of a restricted article sample, not intended audience or actual model-training inclusion.

receipt.public_excerpt: 10% show significant signs of AI authorship.

evidence_items.explanation: The sampled English-language web contains a measurable share of detector-identified AI writing. This does not measure whether those pages were primarily written for robots, so it does not establish the stated antecedent.

The study reports AI-labeled tokens surviving FineWeb filtering and experiments training models with that material. It expressly describes the web text studied as written for human readers, so it cannot substitute for evidence about robot-targeted content.

unresolved_gaps: No representative estimate establishes the share of web content primarily written for robots.
No agreed threshold defines when the antecedent becomes true.
The reviewed evidence does not trace the specified robot-targeted content into representative subsequent production models.
No comparable aggregate measurement settles the human-versus-automation production-capacity component.
